Google LLC today released a new version of Gemini’s Mac client that can interact with other apps on the user’s computer. The feature is available in the U.S. on launch. It requires a Google AI subscription, which equips consumer Google accounts with a broader lineup of artificial intelligence tools. The offering also includes additional storage […]
